cases.description: F-LIFETIME runtime-plugin teardown: 100 real load/unload cycles (TransitionToLauncher unload) + 10 fresh launches/closes. Each child asserts OnDetach before destructors before FreeLibrary, every owned resource (texture, framebuffer, module component, EntitySelection listener, log sink, job, file watcher) released, no callback after unload, and scenario-owned threads back to the warmed baseline.
